feats.label: Polling lead vs best opponent (pts)
feats.desc: Candidate's polling average minus the best opponent's.

feats.label: District presidential lean (pts)
feats.desc: How much more the DISTRICT voted for this candidate's party than the nation did in the last presidential election, on this year's district lines (blank for Senate and Governor races, which use the state lean).

feats.label: Share of race cash on hand
feats.desc: Candidate's cash on hand as a share of the race total (latest FEC report).

feats.label: Most recent poll (%)
feats.desc: The candidate's share in the most recent dated poll.

feats.label: State presidential lean (pts)
feats.desc: How much more the state voted for this candidate's party than the nation did in the last presidential election (state-level, even for House).

feats.label: Polling lead x recency
feats.desc: Polling lead discounted by how stale the latest poll is - a fresh lead counts more than an old one.

feats.label: Lead in nonpartisan polls (pts)
feats.desc: Lead over the best opponent, nonpartisan polls only.

feats.label: Candidate's party holds this seat
feats.desc: 1 if the candidate's PARTY currently holds this seat (party-level, not personal incumbency).

feats.label: Individual-donor share of funds
feats.desc: Share of the candidate's money from individual donors.

feats.label: Consumer sentiment (for the president's party)
feats.desc: Consumer sentiment against its long-run average, counted for the president's party when high.

feats.label: Recency-weighted polling lead (pts)
feats.desc: Recency-weighted polling lead over the best opponent.

feats.label: Share of race cash on hand
feats.desc: Candidate's cash on hand as a share of the race total (latest FEC report).

feats.label: Polling lead vs best opponent (pts)
feats.desc: Candidate's polling average minus the best opponent's.

feats.label: District presidential lean (pts)
feats.desc: How much more the DISTRICT voted for this candidate's party than the nation did in the last presidential election, on this year's district lines (blank for Senate and Governor races, which use the state lean).

feats.label: Recency-weighted polling avg (%)
feats.desc: Polling average where a poll's weight halves every 14 days, so recent polls count most.

feats.label: Consumer sentiment (for the president's party)
feats.desc: Consumer sentiment against its long-run average, counted for the president's party when high.

feats.label: Polling avg, final 30 days (%)
feats.desc: Average over polls taken in the final 30 days before the election.

feats.label: Candidate's party holds this seat
feats.desc: 1 if the candidate's PARTY currently holds this seat (party-level, not personal incumbency).

feats.label: Share of race fundraising
feats.desc: Candidate's share of ALL money raised in the race - donors are forecasters with skin in the game.

feats.label: Two-party polled margin (pts)
feats.desc: Polled Dem-minus-Rep margin, signed toward this candidate.
